facts.fact: Cabo Verde's national statistics institute INE, presenting its continuous multi-purpose survey IMC 2024, gives 76.3% of the population aged 10 and over as owning a mobile phone.
Balai reports INE's 2025 ICT statistics report says 78.2% of people aged 10 and over in Cabo Verde own a mobile phone.
